en.title: The familiar Buddhist list (16 names)
en.phrase: Recall the names in the Anguttara Nikaya sequence used in this guide.
en.decryption: Anga, Magadha, Kasi, Kosala, Vajji, Malla, Chedi, Vatsa, Kuru, Panchala, Matsya, Surasena, Assaka (Asmaka), Avanti, Gandhara, Kamboja.
